The Realms of Legend in the year 305 boasts a population of 29,000 civilized beings ranging from Dwarfs, Humans, Elves and evil nasty goblins.

The world is one of war, Dying legends and the end times of the age of myth, My goal is to document the history and report on the events of this world as they happen.

A gods-eye of the world in the year 305

The Chronicle of Tekud Phrasecharm

In the years of Smata Olzul's recent history we searched for a Citizen of this world who has seen a some historical events still living in memory to only a few citizens, Enter Tekkud phrasecharm, An old crone we found in a hovel located in the hamlet of Daubinn which is the unofficial capital the Confederacies of Uttering, A populous human civilization consisting of many many hamlets stretching from the Eastern shores to the Western Sea

When consulting the census data in the confederacies we know that Tekud was born in the town of Ivoryspun, A Tiny hamlet with a population barely scratching 100 humans in the year 205, making her one of the oldest humans living today at the age of 99, although she lusts for immortality and Constantly prays to Reko the god of murder to grant her such a boon.

When speaking to the villagers they tell us that Tekud is known across the lands for many great deeds, She was once a great general leading the armies of man against the goblin menace, A rare position for a woman, Especially one of no direct noble lineage.

From interviewing Tekud we know that her life has been marred by tragedy, at the age of 9 several of her friends were killed and and she was wounded when a creature from the woods ransacked their town during the night.

At the age of 11 she was married to the twelve year old Alir Covereagles, The great, great grandson of a king well over 100 years long dead, her parents arranged this in the hope that it would raise her standing in life from their tiny peasant town, Thos was so as the couple moved all the way to the western town of fleshpearls to seek work, there she worked as a dancer to make ends meet.

Here she worked until at the age of 22 war struck the nation, the conflict of Eviscerators was the 5th deadliest conflict in the history of the world in which Om "bloodletter" Pulleycrow, king of the humans launched a conquest into goblin lands, this reached its pinnacle in the clashes of boring where many goblins died but also 5 percent of the Confederacies population were butchered. , Tekud was a young soldier during the conflict, after the war she went back to dancing.

The dancing went on until she got old and nobody wanted her anymore, But then fortune found itself in an apprenticeship with the old elf Ada Leafysnarl who taught her masonry and complex engraving, Six year later Tekud moved to Daubinn to ply her trade.

However this was short lived.

Tekud the Warlord

Thanks to her marriage to Alir and the slowly growing insanity of the King she received a letter during the fall of 253, that she was to lead a battalion of almost 500 soldiers to attack a goblin settlement, Although inexperienced and getting older at the age of 48 she succeeded with only 198 losses compared to well over 2,000 goblins dead, A HERO OF THE CONFEDERACY!!!

This was not without loss though, tekud had brought Alir on the campaign with her to stand by her side so that they may face the enemy as husband and wife, unfortunately Alir caught an arrow to the face from an elven slave during the opening stages of the battle.

The journey home took three years and although she was granted a triumph on her return she still missed her lover, for 34 years they had been married and ironically it was his lineage that had allowed her to be boosted so high into society.

The General

The years went on and tekud "the witch" continued to wage wars for her rulers to purge the goblin plague.

The Scorching conflict of clubs:, year 264, 48 humans dead, 745 goblins dead.

The Routed Clash, Year 275, 14 Humans dead, 111 Goblins dead.

The years took there toll and she became an old woman who led young men to their deaths, many campaigns were held to oust the goblins from the realms of man.

In-between she knitted and grieved over Alir at their home back in Daubinn.

Her final wars were as commander in chief of the Seige of Daggers against the great goblin pit of Leperfiend and the sacking of the goblin town of stretchedlie ending in 297.

Now she resides in Daubinn in the year 305, Old, frail and unassuming however tekud Phrasecharm the witch of the confederacy has resulted in well over 5,000 goblin lives ended, A true hero of the confederacy.

Daily Devotional

July 29

4 For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is God. 5 And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after; 6 But Christ as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end. (Hebrews 3:4-6 KJV)

These verses have been comparing and showing that Jesus was superior to Moses in all things. Even though every house is built by a man, God was the ultimate builder of everything. Even though Moses was a faithful servant of the Lord, he was only a servant, whereas Jesus was the Son of God and the Creator of all things including Moses (Ephesians 3:9). The Creator is always greater than His creation, so Jesus was definitely greater than Moses in all ways.

Christ is over His own house, and we are His house, or body, the very Temple of God (1 Corinthians 3:16). As long as we stay faithful to the end, we will always be the house of the Lord. What a tremendous thought, to be the dwelling place of Jesus (Galatians 4:6) and the whole Godhead. Wow, we should stop and ponder that for awhile, as to have God Almighty living inside us is just hard to comprehend. Thank you Lord for Your coming and living in your Saints.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
